Comments.Author: Copilot
Comments.Body: Implemented chat-side Accept/Respond/Reject controls with a required shared revision note for Respond, persisted the note in saved chat sessions, and summarized revision requests in the trace as `Agent writes sent back for revision` with the proposal id. Validation: focused `dotnet test` filter passed for `MemoryChatAgent_ReturnsProposedWritesWhenApprovalRequired`, `MemoryChatAgent_SubmitsProposalThenRespondsWithRevisionNote`, and `ChatMarkup_ReconcilesApproveAllBatchOutcomesAndPendingState`. Browser verification on `http://localhost:5109/chat` confirmed: empty-note Respond shows `Respond requires a revision note.`; authenticated Respond removes the pending item, switches the status to `No pending write approvals`, adds an `Agent writes sent back for revision` trace entry, and stores the submitted proposal id in chat session storage.
